queries.query: bigville test coverage evidence audit simple scenario
queries.rationale: Bigville's independent scenario coverage audit is the expected answer; Ozagia's Bigville test-coverage audit is a cross-repo lexical competitor one term ahead.

queries.query: bigville simple village boundary audit coverage evidence test
queries.rationale: Bigville's legacy world-side boundary audit is the expected answer; Ozagia's Bigville coverage audit matches more query terms and leads by one term in the lexical baseline.

queries.query: bigville simple village test plan coverage audit results
queries.rationale: Bigville's staged village verification plan is the expected answer; Ozagia's Bigville coverage audit is a competitive cross-repo summary of the same evidence area.

queries.query: ocelot integration baseline workspace profile plan resident
queries.rationale: Bigville's supported Ocelot integration guide is the expected answer; Ozagia's Ocelot workspace plan is the stronger lexical match and an out-of-family competitor.

decision.reason: The mechanism changed the ranking on this sample, but all family queries are constructed near-ties and the sample is not a representative real-query benchmark. The default stays family_boost=False; changing it requires a representative paired evaluation with no regression and a meaningful gain.

limits: One anchor, one declared family member and one unrelated distractor; four constructed family queries plus one control.

The family queries were selected after reading real document titles and paths as near-ties inside the fixed +0.15 boost. They measure the mechanism in this regime, not the rate at which real queries are near-ties.
Lexical search only: it matches node type, key and string attrs such as name/path/title. It does not read document bodies, use embeddings, call a model or fetch the network.
Snapshots are built with --docs features --no-git. Adapter indexers are not loaded, so adapter-produced nodes are absent. The Ocelot and Bigville story is still real source/document data.

Snapshots live in temporary member roots while their Repo attrs record the real checkouts. Federation therefore reports the snapshots as stale with 'snapshot root differs from checkout path'; search still loads and ranks them.
Expected answers are Doc nodes. The matching File node can also appear separately and is not counted as the answer.
The temporary build configurations are evaluation choices (for example, skipped generated run trees); they are recorded for reproduction but are not target-project configuration changes.
The script's own JSON/Markdown reports are excluded from the temporary Ozagia snapshot when they lie under that checkout, so a repeated run does not index its previous report as corpus.
No target checkout is imported or written; no graph file is committed; no commit, network or model call is made.
